Reference count for block cause counters. Counts the number of 10us intervals during which DieCstate entry was blocked at least once by any reason. To calculate percent blocked by a specific reason, divide corresponding block reason counter by this counter value.

Reference count for prevent cause counters. Counts the number of times DieCstate entry was blocked at least once by any reason. To calculate percent blocked by a specific reason, divide corresponding prevent reason counter by this counter value.
